outcomes.name: The change impact assessment has been refined based on pilot learnings
The change impact assessment is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Planning & Risk to identify what needs to change in the change impact assessment before scaling.
Refine the change impact assessment to Planning & Risk based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined change impact assessment covering Planning & Risk ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined change impact assessment for Planning & Risk is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the change impact assessment for Planning & Risk remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the change impact assessment affected People Experience & Culture.
Adapt the change impact assessment relating to People Experience & Culture for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the change impact assessment covering People Experience & Culture to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor People Experience & Culture among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the change impact assessment for People Experience & Culture.
